summary: Beyond Air, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that it regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price rule after a 1-for-20 reverse stock split. The company had received a non-compliance notice in April 2026, a continued-listing decision in May, and a compliance confirmation on August 6, 2026, based on 17 consecutive trading days with closing bid prices at or above $1.00. Nasdaq imposed a one-year discretionary panel monitor. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special situation.
